signal.name: past_relative_momentum
signal.definition: positive iff prior 3-session stock close-to-close return exceeds SPY return

outcome.name: future_excess_close_to_close_percentage_points
outcome.definition: stock next-3-session close return minus SPY next-3-session close return
outcome.severe_downside_threshold: -5% worst future close-to-close stock return within 3 sessions

data_limits: Yahoo Finance Chart data unverified by independent provider
Unadjusted daily closes may be affected by splits and dividends
Historical symbols chosen after exploratory inspection
Survivorship bias and corporate actions require further checks
Data freshness and completeness must be verified
